entities.name: Query SET9 protein
observations: 768 aa, predicted molecular weight 85.1 kDa, basic pI 9.31, and net positive charge at pH 7.
Contains a Pfam SET domain (PF00856) at residues 136–230.
Shows long Lys/Glu/Ser/Pro-rich low-complexity regions, consistent with disordered regulatory segments and nuclear targeting/regulation.
Has 100% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed Neurospora crassa histone-lysine N-methyltransferase Set9 Q7SBJ9.
Strong homology supports histone H4 Lys20 trimethyltransferase activity, but exact experimental status for the submitted sequence is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: Neurospora Set9 Q7SBJ9
observations: Trimethylates Lys20 of histone H4 to produce H4K20me3.
Annotated EC 2.1.1.372 and GO histone H4K20 trimethyltransferase activity.
Localized to nucleus and chromosome in the reviewed annotation.

entities.name: H4K20 trimethylation
observations: L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine → N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 3 H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:64456, with related Rhea entries RHEA:15554 and RHEA:15998.
